codeReview.summary: Pass. The fix commit resolves all three prior blocking findings from round 1: (1) `pull --bench` now executes `run_benchmark(..., save=True)`, (2) pull download output is streamed in real time via `subprocess.Popen` + line forwarding, and (3) benchmark TPS now uses separate timing phases (request start→first token and first token→end), so `prompt_tps` and `gen_tps` are no longer mathematically forced equal. Prior blocking issue status: pull-command#1 resolved, pull-command#2 resolved, bench-command#1 resolved.
